header.title: Consulting
header.lead: I help teams turn uncertain digital needs into reliable software systems: from problem framing and architecture to implementation, delivery discipline, code quality, and team capability building.

data.text: My consulting work sits at the intersection of software engineering research, hands-on product development, university teaching, and partner-based delivery. The archive behind this page covers independent projects, product labs, collaborations with software companies, mentoring engagements, enterprise systems, health and finance-oriented platforms, event-driven integration, and cloud/DevOps industrialization work.

rows: Technical diagnosis
A structured reading of the system, risks, delivery process, codebase, architecture, and team constraints.
A project is blocked, fragile, hard to deploy, hard to test, or hard to explain.
Architecture and framing
Domain maps, target architecture, decomposition strategy, technology choices, trade-off analysis, and implementation roadmap.
A team needs to start, modernize, split, stabilize, or scale a software product.
Hands-on engineering
Backend, frontend, API, mobile, testing, documentation, migration, integration, and release work.
The project needs senior implementation capacity with architectural continuity.
Delivery industrialization
CI/CD pipelines, artifact management, quality gates, environment discipline, packaging, backup, and release traceability.
Manual delivery has become too risky, slow, person-dependent, or difficult to audit.
Training and mentoring
Code review, workshops, pair debugging, architecture clinics, learning paths, and standards that teams can actually use.
A team must grow in autonomy while still shipping real work.
Financial and regulated platforms
Architecture, modular backend design, admin frontends, identity, billing, reporting, and compliance-oriented workflows.
Work around systems where auditability, traceability, data integrity, and role-based access matter.
Health and service platforms
Multi-application ecosystems, service APIs, authentication, notifications, payments, storage, and Angular clients.
Experience with platforms that coordinate users, service providers, benefits, documents, and operational workflows.
ERP and business management
Domain decomposition, product modules, accounting/asset/payroll/mobile components, release packaging, and deployment discipline.
Support for teams maintaining broad product families with many repositories and heterogeneous outputs.
Education and mentoring
Frontend, React, web development, testing, debugging, code review, and developer confidence-building.
Professional mentoring and teaching habits applied to real projects and learning journeys.
Research-to-product engineering
Workflow modeling, service orientation, reusable generators, process runtimes, documentation templates, and scientific utilities.
Transfer of academic software engineering ideas into practical tools and product prototypes.

data.text: I do not see consulting as advice detached from implementation. My strongest contributions happen when I can connect diagnosis, modeling, code, tests, delivery, documentation, and people. The goal is not only to ship a feature or install a tool, but to leave behind a system that the team can understand, extend, operate, and teach to the next person.
